source:
@@U02366@@
Hooo! Hooo! I see I’ve come in the nick of time and name the lot of you a tawdry mess! But my special target is Lady Victory up there. With her white wings spread she thinks she’s an eagle, no doubt, and everything she sees she thinks is hers, people and lands alike. But bring me face to face with what is praiseworthy, and my anger rages. I bring the high low, and the low high, make crooked the straight, and the straight crooked. That alone is the source of my health. That is how I want it on earth.

@@U02368@@
Evil cur! Take this! This commanding stroke of my pious staff! Cringe now, writhe and twist! But what’s this? The double-masked dwarf crumples to a hideous shapeless mass! What is this miracle? The mass becomes an egg that swells and bursts, and out of it a pair of twins, an adder and a bat! The one crawls off in the dust, the other flies to the rafters! They hurry off to meet outside. I think wouldn’t care to join them.

@@U02370@@
—Hurry! There’s dancing over there! —No! I wish I was out of here! —Do you feel the spells they're weaving, that crew?
translation:
@@U02366@@
呼！呼！我知道我来得正是时候，把你们这些人称为庸俗的烂摊子！但我的特别目标是上面的胜利女神。毫无疑问，张开白色的翅膀，她认为自己是一只鹰，她认为所看到的一切都是她的，无论是人民还是土地。但当我面对值得赞扬的事情时，我的愤怒就会爆发。我把高调低，把低调高，把弯的变成直的，把直的变成弯的。仅此一点就是我健康的源泉。这就是我在地球上想要的样子。

@@U02368@@
邪恶的恶棍！拿着这个！我虔诚的员工的这一命令！现在就畏缩、扭动、扭曲！但这是什么？戴着双层面具的矮人崩溃成一团可怕的、不成形的东西！这是什么奇迹？这团东西变成了一颗鸡蛋，膨胀并破裂，从里面生出一对双胞胎：一条蝰蛇和一只蝙蝠！一只在尘土中爬行，另一只飞到房梁上！他们赶紧去外面见面。我想我不会愿意加入他们。

@@U02370@@
——快点！那边正在跳舞！ -不！我希望我能离开这里！ ——那些船员们，你感觉到他们正在编织的咒语了吗？
